method.archive: Concatenate manifest parts in order and read tar.xz; each member reproduces the full uncompressed original JSON byte-for-byte.
method.http_identity: First-attempt byte digests compared when both phases emit an operation_id; response-derived identifiers can differ across clones. Exact-profile requests and final state are independently validated.
method.paired_changes: Per-replicate candidate minus A, shown as median/min/max of paired absolute and percentage changes. Zero baseline leaves the percentage undefined; one HTTP repeat is descriptive.
method.pairing: Compare arms only within the same case, fixture, repeat, CPU affinity and harness. Outcome, family/sample size and measurement windows differ across cases.
method.per_agent_rle: For agents in index order, [consecutive agents, fulfilled operations, assigned operations].
method.postgres_cpu: Not available in this harness. Raw pg_cluster_cpu_seconds omits backends when proc task children is unavailable.
method.rss: HTTP sums per-worker peaks, which need not coincide. Exact records also retain before/after and lifetime process peak.
method.sql_json: Exact requests instrument psycopg encode/decode; HTTP SQL statistics cover statements, not decoded byte counts.
